subject: Space/Time Continuum
author: ZombieTron
body:
Time going faster means you are getting old dude! Older anyway!! 😉

I don't get the thing about connecting with old friends on Facebook (or one of the many other social network sites available). I just think if I wanted to keep in touch with friends from school, I wouldn't have lost touch with them in the first place. Ofcourse I haven't kept in touch with any of them, and I cancelled my MySpace and Friends Reunited accounts when people from school contacted me because I realised I don't actually want to know any of them anyway, which is why I don't know them.

But, maybe that says more about me then anything else. I am happy for you Ichi, it is good to have friends! I hope you can make the time to maintain the friendships that are important to you. 🙂

oh... and Burnout isn't dead! Take back that blasphemous statement!!! LOL! 😃
